def process(identity_theft_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = identity_theft_reports.copy()
    # Skip header rows and clean up
    df = df.iloc[1:].copy()
    df.columns = ['Theft_Type', 'Theft_Subtype', 'Num_Reports', 'Pct_Diff']
    # Remove all-null and source rows
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[~df['Theft_Type'].str.contains('Source:', case=False, na=False)]
    # Clean up the number format (remove commas)
    df['Num_Reports'] = df['Num_Reports'].str.replace(',', '')
    df['Num_Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Num_Reports'], errors='coerce')
    return df.dropna(subset=['Num_Reports'])
